assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background plate for a 16:9 in-game cinematic in a hand-painted biological fantasy action game. Create ONE wide landscape illustration, no panels. Primary subject: unmistakable semi-transparent human body seen frontally from the full head through the hips and upper thighs, shoulders and both arms visible, occupying the middle-right two thirds. Smooth luminous translucent ivory and pale mint human silhouette, anatomically recognizable head, neck, shoulders, torso, waist. Inside the torso, clearly readable paired lungs in soft pale coral, a warmly glowing heart between them and a fine branching vascular network. Scene: deep ink green atmospheric space surrounding the body, soft mist and dust, generous dark negative space on the left and lower edge for later program-added titles. Style: exquisite hand-painted game concept illustration, softly outlined ivory ceramic-like membranes, watercolor softness with tactile painterly details, restrained muted sage and pale mint, pearl white, gentle warm coral; luminous storybook medical fantasy, coherent with soft organic shell buildings and miniature immune-cell characters. Lighting: warm heart glow and cool mint rim light, subtle depth, cinematic. The body must be the focus, large and readable at small screen sizes. Healthy body and organs only, no painted infection. No characters, no troops, no monsters, no weapons. No text, letters, numerals, diagrams, labels, HUD, borders, logos or watermark. Not a photograph, not clinical anatomical gore, no exposed flesh, no bones, no horror, no holographic grid. Full-bleed 16:9 landscape.
